purpose: Test prospective territorial interval coverage after combining the selected national point/uncertainty with the validated lambda=0.5 geography and conditional historical geography residuals, without double-counting national shocks.

national_component.prequential_scale_rule: maximum national residual RMSE whose target year is at or before the scored fold origin

geography_component.center_formula: national_draw + 0.5*(origin_territory_share-origin_national_share), then positive row normalization and weighted raking to the exact same national draw
geography_component.origin_weight: valid local-ballot votes available at the fold origin
geography_component.reason_not_clr_sampling: Historical zero/near-zero cells generate extreme CLR residuals that are valid diagnostics but unstable direct Monte Carlo support.
geography_component.residual_row_sampling: Sample complete nine-party residual rows with replacement; preserve within-row cross-party dependence; assign exchangeably across target territories.
geography_component.post_residual_projection: floor at 1e-10, normalize each territory row, then rake every 92-territory draw back to that draw's exact national vector using origin valid-vote weights.

prequential_support.2007_TO_2011: TRAINING_GEOGRAPHY_SUPPORT_ONLY; 57 conservative explicit one-to-one residual rows; not scored because no earlier comparable territorial residual library is available.
prequential_support.2011_TO_2016: Score all 92 target territories using only 2007_TO_2011 geography residual rows.
prequential_support.2016_TO_2021: Score all 92 target territories using pooled 2007_TO_2011 plus 2011_TO_2016 geography residual rows.

simulation.national_seed_rule: Reuse national uncertainty coverage seeds 26092600 + transition index in [2002_TO_2007,2007_TO_2011,2011_TO_2016,2016_TO_2021]

coverage_gate.pooled_unit: territory x party x scored fold; 92*9*2 = 1656 cells

required_invariants: Every simulated territorial row is finite, non-negative and sums to one.
Every simulated 92-territory weighted aggregate matches its exact national draw within 1e-8.
Only residual rows whose target year is at or before the scored fold origin are sampled.
No realized scored-fold national or territorial outcome enters its forecast draws.
The residual sampling uses complete nine-party rows, never independently sampled party components.
failure_policy: If pooled 80% or 95% coverage misses its frozen threshold, final 2026 probabilities remain NOT_PROMOTED. Any V2 uncertainty rule must be frozen before being scored and may not be tuned to individual party misses.
limitations: Only two full 92-territory folds can be prospectively scored because 2007_TO_2011 supplies the first comparable geography residual library.
Residual rows are exchangeable across territories; territory-specific variance cannot be estimated robustly from this history.
The gate validates marginal cell interval coverage, not the complete joint dependence of all 92 territories.
